items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And, I joined his band and played with him for a while.

ctx.x: He said, 'So, I'm going to take this position and you guys have been all right, and blah, blah.' So, then, I came back to Chicago, see, and I joined -- re-joined Earl.
